davina-larose.title: The Ballad of Davina Larose
davina-larose.description: A gothic tale from the South inspired by Edgar Allan Poe. A lover catching glimpses of his lost Davina Larose under the stars of Lousiana.
davina-larose.shortDescription: A country rock ballad about a lover catching glimpses of his lost Davina Larose under the stars of Lousiana

the-living-archive.title: The Living Archive
the-living-archive.description: A 10 track album turning famous poems into songs of all genres. A modern take on the classics.
the-living-archive.shortDescription: A 10 track album turning classic poems into songs of all genres.

diamond-cut.title: Diamond Cut Sorrow
diamond-cut.description: A dark theatrical song about the temptation and pain of making art. Giving you a glimpse behind the mask of a mad man.
diamond-cut.shortDescription: Dark theatrical song about the temptation and pain of making art.
